summary: Read a line of houses as non-negative integers, each integer the cash stored in one house. If two houses that stand next to each other are both entered on the same night, an alarm sounds. Chosen houses therefore cannot be neighbors. Skipping any number of houses is allowed, and choosing no house is allowed. Write the largest sum of cash that can be taken on that single night. House order is the order you read. With only one house, the result is the cash in that house.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
